rpcUrl: redacted/read-only RPC; see fetch command in README
notes: This file is rebuilt offline from committed validator_state/specific_delegator_state JSON plus committed delegate/undelegate CSV evidence.
Delegate/undelegate event totals are bounded to the canonical snapshot block when eventWindowCanonicalToSnapshot is true.
Validator and specific-delegator state files record blockTag=77822541; these state reads are bounded to the canonical snapshot block.
executionStakeMON is the staking precompile execution view for the recorded validator_state blockTag.
consensusStakeMON is the stake currently used by consensus for the recorded validator_state blockTag.
snapshotStakeMON is the staking snapshot view for epoch transition logic at the recorded validator_state blockTag.
Event totals are historical flow metrics. Current on-chain validator state is reported separately from event math.
Validator stake is not creator revenue; it is MON committed to validator operations.
